_comment: Example config: competitive intelligence on AI coding assistants. 'Acme Assist' / 'Acme' are placeholders: set perspective to your own product. {product}, {company} and {market} are substituted into edition text.

competitors.name: Cursor / Anysphere
search_terms: Cursor AI code editor OR Anysphere

_entities_comment: Extra story-ledger entities: {canonical-slug: [surface forms]}. Only named forms, never generic phrases.
broad_queries: AI code review funding OR acquisition {year}
AI coding tools security OR regulation
_feeds_comment: filter=true keeps only items matching feed_keywords or a competitor name/alias. Optional per-feed user_agent for sites that bot-wall the default.

main.title: AI Coding Assistants — Competitive Briefing
main.reader: a Product Manager working on {product} at {company}
main.regulatory_scope: in the UK, EU and US
sections: Social Chatter (practitioner reactions from Reddit, Hacker News, social media)

pt-br.title: Assistentes de Código com IA — Briefing Competitivo
pt-br.reader: a Product Manager in Brazil working on {product} at {company} for the Brazilian and Latin American market
pt-br.regulatory_scope: in Brazil and Latin America (e.g. the AI bill PL 2338/2023, ANPD guidance on AI and personal data), plus major UK/EU/US developments that set precedent globally
pt-br.extra_needs:
- The Brazilian and Latin American market for {market}: local players, global vendors entering the region, and adoption by companies there

SCOPE: this is NOT a regional-only briefing. Global news that matters to anyone working on {product} — a competitor launch, a pricing change, a major deal — belongs in it exactly as it would in the main edition, whether or not it mentions Brazil. The regional focus ADDS Brazil and Latin America coverage on top. Regional searches return more low-value content than global ones: skip SEO/marketing posts, evergreen explainers and course adverts.
pt-br.language_rule: LANGUAGE: write the entire briefing (headings, summaries, commentary, action items) in Brazilian Portuguese (pt-BR). Keep product/company names and verbatim quotes in their original language; a quote in English or Spanish may be followed by a short pt-BR translation in brackets. reported_items headline/summary also in pt-BR.
sections: Comunidade (reações de desenvolvedores no Reddit, Hacker News e redes sociais)

regional_queries.q: GitHub Copilot OR Cursor desenvolvedores Brasil
